test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

Everybody wants others to respect them.

options.text: Everybody wanted to be respected by others.
Everybody wants to be respected by others.
They want others to be respected by everybody.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the sentence, the active voice is changed to the passive voice.
 
• The object of the **active voice **(others) becomes the subject in the** passive voice.**
 
• The verb form changes to include the appropriate form of '**to be'** (here, '**to be respected**'). As it is an infinitive statement.
 
• The subject of the active voice (Everybody) becomes the object in the passive voice.
 
• Hence, the transformation is done correctly in option 2.

Hence, the correct statement is **'*Everybody wants to be respected by others*.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The passive voice is used to emphasize the action rather than the doer.
 
• In the passive voice, the focus is on the recipient of the action.
 
• Example:
 
 
• Active:* **"I have to do this work."***
 
• Passive: "***This work has to be done."***
